                                               NOTICE

    (This notice is issued with the approval of the Principal, Rangapara College (Autonomous))

This is for the general information of all students of UG and PG 3rd Semester (Arts, Science, Commerce
ITEP and MA-Hindi), Batch 2025, that the course registration for all the programmes will be open from
24/09/2026 to 29/09/2026. Students are required to complete the registration process by visiting the
following website:

https://rcr.samarth.edu.in/

Without course registration, students will not be able to submit the examination form. After Course
registration students must submit the printed copy of their course registration form at the college along
with admit card/marksheet of the last appeared examination. On submission the registered subjects
will be verified and only forms with correct subject selection will be accepted.

For any clarification regarding course registration, UG students may contact the following Assistant Officer
In-charges of 2nd Semester UG Examinations, 2026:

    1. Dr. Kiran Jyoti Mohan         : 6002798962
    2. Dr. Paresh Borah              : 9101370923
    3. Ms Priyadarshani Baruah       : 6900979932
